text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Thank you, Onii-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Thank you, Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know, Rice... I could hear everyone's 
voices, even while I was running.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best!" "Rice-chan!" Everyone's 
cheers kept pushing Rice forward.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, Rice is no good, huh... Even 
though I decided that I'd make everyone 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
To think that Rice would be the one 
feeling happier...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... I was so truly happy...! I'm so 
glad I got to run in the Takarazuka 
Kinen...!
choice_data_list: Everyone else is thinking the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone else too...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Riceee!! Thank you sooo much!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
This year's Takarazuka Kinen was seriously 
the best!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Amazing...! So many... smiling 
faces...!
choice_data_list: You're the one who protected this smile.
You're the one who protected this smile.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Rice did...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... No way. Blue roses don't bring 
sorrow—they bring happiness, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"And a wonderful presence who brings a 
smile to everyone's face—"
choice_data_list: See, it's just like Rice is now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...I see... Rice... did it too...?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was really able... to make everyone 
happy...!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu... Uwaaaaaaaa~~hh!!

As she burst into tears with trembling 
shoulders, the audience showered her with 
warm applause.
And night fell—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*... *exhale*...
choice_data_list: You've stopped crying now, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I can't stay crying forever.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Because on this stage, I want to properly 
convey my feelings to everyone with a 
smile."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you all for supporting Rice up 
until today."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She told me, "—Tonight, Rice will make 
everyone happy."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Did I go a bit too far?
choice_data_list: That's not an exaggeration at all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! If you say so, Big 
Brother, everything will be fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! If you say so, Big Sister, 
everything will be fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I'm off. To where everyone 
is.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

And on that day, Rice Shower delivered the 
best live performance to the audience.

The next day, her concert was heavily 
featured on the front page of the 
newspaper.

—The star that bloomed on the turf of 
Yodo. The beautiful blue rose, Rice 
Shower.
...The next day.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Big Brother!! Rice wants to run in the 
Arima Kinen!!
choice_data_list: You've already decided on a new goal?!
You've already decided on a new goal?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Sister!! Rice wants to run in the 
Arima Kinen!!
choice_data_list: You've already decided on a new goal?!
You've already decided on a new goal?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because, you see, guess what! In the 
next Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I heard both Bourbon-san and McQueen-san 
are running!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why Rice wants to run too! And I 
want to have the “best race ever”!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Wah! Thank you, Onii-sama!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Wah! Thank you, Onee-sama!!

Just like the Takarazuka Kinen, the Arima 
Kinen is a race that only Umamusume who 
have won the hearts of the fans can enter.

"The fact that she became able to say 'I 
want to race,' regardless of the entry 
conditions. That means—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fweh? Rice hasn't grown any taller, 
though...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ? ...Then what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-Tell me! Big Brother~!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-Tell me! Big Sister~!!

...And so, Rice Shower ended up following 
me around for the rest of the day.
